enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Pulls blanket. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up on bed. Swings legs over side. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Turns off tap. Picks up towel. Wipes face. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Takes out pan from cabinet. Places pan on induction cooker. Turns on induction cooker. Cracks eggs into pan. Stirs eggs. Turns off induction cooker. Puts bread in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Waits for toast. Takes plate from cabinet. Puts eggs on plate. Takes toast from toaster. Puts toast on plate. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed for work and checking phone for shift notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out work clothes. Takes off pajamas. Puts on work clothes. Zips up. Walks to desk. Picks up phone. Presses power button. Unlocks phone. Opens messaging app. Reads shift notes. Types reply. Puts down phone. Checks mirror. Adjusts clothes. Puts on shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Locks door. Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens door. Sits in driver's seat. Buckles seatbelt. Starts engine. Adjusts mirror. Drives. Turns on radio. Stops at traffic lights. Parks car. Turns off engine. Unbuckles seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Locks car. Walks to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care during the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enters hospital. Walks to locker room. Changes into scrubs. Puts on PPE. Picks up patient chart. Walks to patient room. Washes hands. Enters room. Greets patient. Checks vital signs. Administers medication. Talks to patient. Updates chart. Attends meeting. Assists doctor. Takes lunch break. Eats lunch. Returns to ward. Checks on patients. Responds to call button. Documents notes.

Walks to car. Unlocks car. Opens door. Sits in driver's seat. Buckles seatbelt. Starts engine. Drives. Stops at traffic lights. Parks at home. Turns off engine. Unbuckles seatbelt. Opens door. Gets out. Locks car. Walks to house. Unlocks door. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Takes off work clothes. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Wraps towel around hair. Puts on clean clothes. Hangs wet towel. Turns off light. Walks out.

Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Takes out cutting board. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds ingredients. Stirs. Turns off induction cooker. Takes plate. Serves food. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Picks up remote. Presses power button. Sits on sofa. Changes channels. Watches TV. Adjusts volume. Puts down remote. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Gets glass of water. Walks back. Sits on sofa. Continues watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to read health news and catch up on messages
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to computer. Turns on computer. Sits on chair. Opens browser. Types web address. Reads health news. Scrolls. Clicks links. Opens messaging app. Types messages. Sends messages. Reads replies. Closes browser. Turns off computer. Stands up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Washes face. Dries face. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV in bed and unwinding
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on TV. Sits on bed. Changes channels. Watches TV. Lies down. Pulls blanket. Continues watching. Turns off TV. Puts remote on nightstand. Closes eyes.
Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep.
